dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical geometric narrowing of the 2D profile from the maximum width at the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins along the visible length with no detectable asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white baseline with uniform reflectance across the dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark circular mark located on the upper-left anterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark circular mark on the anterior left dorsal quadrant.
